statement: All 7 analysed contemporary picture books run 12 spreads; the 6 with text have 136-220 words in total (median 154), about 13 words per spread.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2025)

analyst_note: 2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Caution: all 7 are Book Dash, whose format fixes the spread count, so more Book Dash books do not answer the one-publisher objection; a second source is still required.

magicpaper.suggested: Similar total length, but these books spend it on ~12 page turns of ~10-20 words. Worth testing shorter pages and more turns once the corpus is larger.
magicpaper.note: One publisher, one country. Do not act on this before ≥10 books from ≥2 sources agree.
